## UseWheelZoomOptions.onPan property

When provided, a plain wheel/trackpad scroll \*pans\* by the scroll delta (in pixels) and zooming requires Ctrl/⌘ — which is also what a trackpad pinch reports — instead of every wheel tick zooming. Suits surfaces that are mostly scrolled through (a long alignment or tree).

**Signature:**

```typescript
onPan?: (dxPixels: number, dyPixels: number) => void;
```
